capabilities: run an HTTP-based MCP server inside Obsidian
expose tools to read, search, and list notes
create, edit, rename, and delete notes via MCP
control access with bearer tokens and path ACLs
bridge stdio to HTTP for Claude Desktop
extras: Desktop only; does not work on mobile. Flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README notes the tool list in the README is only a summary, with the source file as the source of truth.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for external LLM clients like Claude Desktop or Open WebUI to access and edit vault notes through a controlled protocol.

relations.evidence: Supports HTTP transport natively (Open WebUI, remote LLMs)
Claude Desktop uses stdio transport for MCP servers, so you'll need the mcp-bridge.js script
Assuming you have the BRAT plugin installed and enabled

requires.name: An MCP client such as Open WebUI, Claude Code, or Claude Desktop
Node.js 18+ for the Claude Desktop stdio bridge

summary: MCP server plugin that runs inside Obsidian and exposes vault notes to external LLM tools over HTTP with read, search, and edit operations.
